title: rotate status --json
description: The rows printed by `rotate status --json` (SHA-263): one object per rotation in progress, or per rotation with `--all`, sorted by rotation_id. Read from the state file and audit log only. Holds fingerprints, references and redacted errors only, never a secret value. The exit code is 3 when any rotation in the state file is pending (shown or not), otherwise 0.

rollback_in_progress.description: A rollback has started and not finished; the table shows the step as `rolling_back (<step>)`.

updated_seconds_ago.description: Seconds from updated_at to now by the clock status ran with; the table shows it as relative time.

revoke_not_before.description: Earliest time the old secret may be revoked, as recorded.

revoke_remaining_seconds.description: Seconds until revoke_not_before, 0 once it has passed. Null unless step is pending_revoke.

failed_step.description: The step that failed (step failed) or could not continue (step needs_rollback).

pending.description: True at created, consumers_updated, verified, pending_revoke, failed, needs_rollback or revoke_manual, or while a rollback is in progress. Any pending rotation makes the exit code 3.

hint.description: What to do next, one line. At revoke_manual it holds the provider's instructions for deleting the old secret by hand.

error.description: The error of the rotation's last audit entry, when that entry has one and its outcome is not ok.
